Production overlap observes routes at end-of-position, stores previous_routes, and later prepare touches their recency again. cache_quiesce drains pending maintenance and clears previous_routes.

A fresh direct two-row frozen interval with chronological single-touch prepare has a different recency policy. P210 must state this and compare serial/chunk under the same direct policy, not claim production overlap-policy equivalence.

Publish retains raw pinned staging and 144 destination pointers; allocation IDs/captured pointer values do not independently lease hidden storage. Retain owner/staging until completion and forbid consumers during mutation.
After layer-major execution, shared route workspace must have been copied per row/layer before reuse; replay chronology is row0 layers0..47 then row1 layers0..47.
Partial victim fill or table publication can change bytes before failure. Poison and prevent new readers/commit; no atomic rollback or hardware fence claim follows from CPU metadata.
